<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—a dominant peak at m/z 235.14 with successive peaks at +1 Da (≈16 % intensity) and +2 Da (≈4–5 % intensity) that follow the expected decreasing pattern for ^13C contributions—we can definitively confirm the presence of carbon. No other element shows its characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl M+2 ≈ 33 %, Br M+2 ≈ 100 %, S M+2 ≈ 4 %) in this spectrum. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
